answer: Agents register TPM/SGX enclave keys with zero-knowledge attestation proving measured code and a VDF-bound nonce. The ridge state tree commits keys, the meadow consensus contract checks proofs, and the spiral hash anchor blocks replay. Forging N identities requires provisioning N physical enclaves or compromising them and solving N VDFs; an O(N^2) bonding curve and irreversible slashing impose superlinear capital loss.
